title: Cross-platform seekable evidence ZIP
details: MP4 evidence is fast-start repaired again at the final ZIP boundary so older and newer recordings cannot bypass the seek repair during export
Video and audio files are stored in the ZIP using standard STORE mode instead of DEFLATE so archive viewers are not forced to expose them as one-way compressed streams
PDF and document entries remain DEFLATE-compressed, so the evidence pack remains a normal compressed ZIP
The MP4 video data is not re-encoded, so video and audio quality are unchanged
The evidence format is designed for IQA/EQA use across different Windows, macOS and browser/player setups with direct timeline seeking
